entries.scope: G3 no-IALMob Id-Vg, Vd=0.1 V, exact SProcess topology, Vg=0.1667--0.8333 V
entries.observation: Vela resolved P95 current error is 0.287023 dex and the fixed-current equivalent threshold shift is 29.6262 mV. G3 identical-state edge-SG differs by 11.06--24.50 times, but G4 no-HFS replay collapses to about 1.06 times at the two resolved representative points. Sentaurus element fields identify an interior GradQF plus contact-boundary ElectricField fallback HFS support. The remaining G4 self-consistent midrange current factor is about 1.9 and is not explained by the existing cotangent or node-volume controls.
excluded_causes: uniform electrostatic, flatband, or reference-energy offset
electron-density reconstruction from psi and QF
mixed-Voronoi node volume in fixed-state SG replay
WP1.5 low-current KCL and line-search floor
open_causes: missing contact-boundary ElectricField fallback in the otherwise GradQF-driven HFS support
G4 self-consistent state feedback or box-coefficient semantics beyond the existing cotangent fallback control
generalized SRH hole-QF reference convention; low impact on current Id-Vg but material for recombination qualification
entries.expires_when: A contact-boundary HFS fallback passes G3/G4 identical-state replay and the full 31-point G3 curve is rerun; remaining G4 coefficient/state feedback and SRH reference semantics are then requalified, or the exact mesh/discretization contract changes.
